tracks.title: Pronombre + Modal + Have Been + Verbo ING
tracks.formula: pronombre + modal + have + been + VERBO + ING + complemento
tracks.example: She must have been working.
tracks.bridge: Puente: must have been working = debió haber estado trabajando (modal + have + been + VERBO+ING).

tracks.title: Modal + Have + Participio
tracks.formula: modal + have + PARTICIPIO (should/could/must have + participio)
tracks.example: You should have studied more.
tracks.bridge: Puente: should have = debería haber + participio; could have = podría haber. NO es futuro perfecto (will have).

tracks.title: Futuro perfecto · will have + participio
tracks.formula: pronombre + will + have + PARTICIPIO + complemento
tracks.example: I will have finished by Friday.
never: futuro simple will + base sin have
should have / could have (eso es modal + have)
tracks.bridge: Puente: will have + participio = habrá / habré + participio (acción terminada antes de un punto futuro). I will have finished = yo habré terminado. NO es should have.

tracks.title: Pronombre + Have + Been + Verbo (ING)
tracks.formula: pronombre + have/has/had + been + VERBO + ING + complemento
tracks.example: I have been studying English.
tracks.bridge: Puente: have been + VERBO+ING = he estado + ando/endo (duración hasta ahora).

tracks.title: Have / Has / Had
tracks.formula: have. has. had. — paradigm con pausa
tracks.example: I have finished. / I had finished.
tracks.bridge: Puente: have/has/had — decir con pausa: have. has. had.

tracks.title: If I was / If I were / If I were to
tracks.formula: was = pasado real/posible | were = hipótesis irreal | were to = futuro poco probable
tracks.example: If I were rich, I would travel.
tracks.bridge: Puente: was = pasado real; were = hipótesis irreal (If I were…); were to = poco probable.

tracks.title: Verbos irregulares (Presente / PS / Participio)
tracks.formula: Col1 PRESENTE | Col2 PASADO | Col3 PARTICIPIO — decir con pausa: go. went. gone.
tracks.example: go. went. gone. / do. did. done. — NUNCA pegado
tracks.bridge: Puente: col1 presente / col2 pasado / col3 participio — siempre con pausa: go. went. gone.

tracks.title: There is / There are / To Have / Exist
tracks.formula: There is + 1 | There are + 2+ | Sujeto + have/has (posesión) | There exist(s) (formal)
tracks.example: There is a book on the table. / I have a book.
tracks.bridge: Puente: There is = hay (1); There are = hay (2+); have/has = posesión (no “hay”).

tracks.title: Gerundio = VERBO + ING como sustantivo
tracks.formula: VERBO + ING (= ando/endo) funciona como SUSTANTIVO. Tras prep: preposición + VERBO + ING.
tracks.example: I like running. / Playing guitar is fun.
tracks.bridge: Puente ING — tres formas: (1) TO BE + verbo + ING = presente progresivo = acción en progreso = ando/endo; sin to be no hay ese ING. (2) Verbo + ING sin to be = actividad GENERAL (I like watching TV / dancing / eating). (3) TO + verbo = infinitivo = INTENCIÓN (I like to watch TV). Corrección firma: I like to watch the TV after my work → I like watching TV after work + linker However… Recap: progreso / general / intención.

tracks.title: Gerundio despues de preposicion
tracks.formula: preposición (before/after/without/by/good at) + VERBO + ING (= ando/endo) + complemento
tracks.example: Before leaving, call me. (saliendo → leaving)
tracks.bridge: Puente: OBLIGATORIO: tras prep, VERBO+ING = ando/endo (Before leaving = antes de salir/saliendo). Decí ando/endo. No lo confundas con to be + ING (estar).

tracks.title: Preposiciones de tiempo
tracks.formula: IN (mes/año/parte del día) | ON (día/fecha) | AT (hora puntual)
tracks.example: We meet on Monday in March at 5 pm.
tracks.bridge: Puente: IN = mes/año/parte del día; ON = día/fecha; AT = hora puntual.

tracks.title: Preposiciones IN ON AT BY
tracks.formula: IN = dentro | ON = encima/superficie | AT = punto exacto | BY = medio — van en el complemento
tracks.example: The book is on the table. / I am at home.
tracks.bridge: Puente: IN = dentro; ON = encima; AT = punto; BY = medio — van en el complemento.

tracks.title: Negaciones - AUX + NOT
tracks.formula: pronombre + auxiliar + not + verbo + complemento
tracks.example: I do not work. / She doesn't go.
tracks.bridge: Puente: auxiliar + not + verbo base (I do not work — nunca “I no work”).

tracks.title: Comparativos
tracks.formula: adjetivo-er / more + adjetivo + than | the + adjetivo-est / most + adjetivo | as + adjetivo + as
tracks.example: She is taller than me.
tracks.bridge: Puente: -er/more + than = más… que; -est/most = el más…; as…as = tan…como.

tracks.title: Articulos a/an/the
tracks.formula: a/an (indefinido) | the (definido) | much/many/a lot of
tracks.example: I see a cat. / The cat is black.
tracks.bridge: Puente: a/an = uno/una (indefinido); the = el/la (definido).

tracks.title: Pronombre + To Be + Verbo (ING)
tracks.formula: pronombre + am/is/are + VERBO + ING (= ando/endo) + complemento
tracks.example: I am studying English now.
tracks.bridge: Puente progresivo: TO BE + verbo + ING = presente progresivo = acción en progreso = ando/endo. Regla: sin TO BE no hay ING progresivo. No confundir con I like watching (general) ni I like to watch (intención).

tracks.title: Pronombre + Have/Has + Participio
tracks.formula: have/has + PARTICIPIO (presente perfecto) vs had + PARTICIPIO (pasado perfecto)
tracks.example: He has done it.
tracks.bridge: Puente: have/has + participio = he/ha + participio; had + participio = había + participio (pasado perfecto). NO es pasado simple (worked/went).

tracks.title: Pasado simple PS
tracks.formula: pronombre + verbo(pasado) + complemento
tracks.example: She worked yesterday.
tracks.bridge: Puente: verbo en pasado (worked / went) = ayer/acción terminada. NO es pasado perfecto (had + participio).

tracks.title: Presente simple PR
tracks.formula: pronombre + verbo + complemento (he/she/it + verbo+s)
tracks.example: I go home every day.
tracks.bridge: Puente: hábito/hecho; he/she/it lleva verbo+s (she works).

tracks.title: Pronombre + Modal + Verbo
tracks.formula: pronombre + modal + verbo(base, sin to) + complemento
tracks.example: I can work. / She should study.
tracks.bridge: Puente: will=-ré; would=-ría; should=debería; can=puedo; could=podría — modal + verbo base (sin to).

tracks.title: Metodo moneda (inversion)
tracks.formula: verbo auxiliar ANTES del pronombre = pregunta | DESPUÉS del pronombre = respuesta
tracks.example: Are you coming? / You are coming.
tracks.bridge: Puente: método moneda — auxiliar ANTES del pronombre = pregunta; DESPUÉS = respuesta.

tracks.title: Futuro will / going to
tracks.formula: pronombre + will + verbo + complemento | pronombre + be + going to + verbo + complemento
tracks.example: I will call you tomorrow. / I am going to study.
never: futuro perfecto (will have + participio — otro módulo)
tracks.bridge: Puente: will = -ré (decisión/espontáneo); going to = voy a (plan/intención). Si piden futuro PERFECTO → will have + participio (otro track).

tracks.title: Tiempos overview
tracks.formula: presente simple | pasado simple | presente continuo | presente perfecto | futuro
tracks.example: I work / I worked / I am working / I have worked
never: un solo tiempo como si fuera overview
tracks.bridge: Puente: PR=presente simple; PS=pasado simple; PC=presente continuo; PRP=presente perfecto.
